PARANG DIESEL ‘YAN WATCH: Presiding Officer Sen. Chiz Escudero says Tuesday that he cannot say when Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial will finish as the timeline of the proceedings will now depend on the defense’s presentation of evidence and the length of trial. He says only one defense witness was presented Monday but believes that the proceedings will move forward faster in the coming days. Escudero reiterates, however, his hope that the trial will be completed before Christmas or New Year. #VPonTrial | @bellepechayINQ Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/N3HsBNifqy Watch our livestream here: https://t.co/WPoVOxVRXe
